about: W10.F7: a decision for every open PR whose head is not in the train (npm run train:missing). in = a task or train brings it; rejected = it will not go in, and why; replaced = what carries it instead. A decision is about one head: a PR that moves needs a new one.

No other open PR was undecided against this head. trainHead is the integration head this file was checked against (before this commit): review 11 L13 asks the file to name the train head itself, which a commit of this file cannot do, so train:missing reports that line as stale after the push until the rule reads trainHead as an ancestor.
